mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_NAME, EMAIL, NICKNAME, BIRTH_DATE, GENDER_CODE, PHONE_NUMBER, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET MEMBER_NAME = #{request.name}, NICKNAME = #{request.nickname}, GENDER_CODE = #{request.genderCode}, BIRTH_DATE = #{request.birthDate, jdbcType=DATE}, PHONE_NUMBER = #{request.phoneNumber, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT PASSWORD_HASH FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
